Name: It Takes a Village
Author: SpaghettiCodes
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]Adds new lines for the children of the valley and some of the adults in their lives.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
New line(s) for Jas, Vincent, Leo, Kent, Jodi, Sam, and Marnie.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]Thank you to the creators of content patcher and SMAPI for making this possible.[/color]
[color=#999999]Shout out to Nexus Mods for hosting the Stardew Valley Modfest! I've been thinking about modding for a while, and this gave me a deadline![/color]
[color=#999999]Thank you to modders in the SDV Discord for helping me with some bugs![/color]
[color=#999999]Thank you to the people I work with for inspiring this mod.[/color]
[color=#999999]Last but not least, thank you to those who have downloaded, endorsed, or otherwise supported my mod. It means a lot to me to know that this is valued by and beneficial to the community. Your verbal and nonverbal support encourages me to keep improving my mod. Thanks guys :)[/color]

Manifest.Name: It Takes a Village
Manifest.Description: Small dialogue mod that gives more lines to the children of the valley and their families.
Manifest.Author: SpaghettiCodes
